integrity: The proof establishes the uniform orbit formula independently of finite computations; the 2-factor case is explicitly acknowledged as previously known.
scientific_limitations: Formula applies only to finite nonempty point sets in rational-chain powers of dimension at least three.
No asymptotics or independent mathematical review claimed.
Older higher-dimensional incidence-array priority cannot be ruled out.
title: A partition-Möbius orbit formula for finite subsets of rational chain products
